_comment: Demo consumers per workspace. These stand in for diners who signed up in the CUSTOMER's own product — Ember & Oak's app in Austin, Nolan's ordering site in Denver — not people an admin typed into WorkVibe. `provision.mjs users` upserts them and adds each one to the all-subscribers list; joining that list is what emits $USER_ENTERED_LIST and welcomes them, the way a real signup would. An existing member does not re-enter, so re-running never re-welcomes anyone. The first entry in each list is the preview recipient every template's mock_data points at; keep it. Sam Rivera appears in both rosters on purpose — one person can be a diner of two chains. All addresses are @example.com (IANA-reserved, cannot receive mail).
